name: vscode-editor-mcp
description: Exposes VS Code's live editor state and editor actions to external MCP clients over a loopback HTTP server.

vscodeEditorMcp.autoStart.description: Start the MCP server automatically when this window opens. Off by default because the server listens on a local network port.

vscodeEditorMcp.port.description: Port to listen on. 0 lets the OS pick a free port, which is required if you run more than one VS Code window. Clients discover the real port via the discovery file.

vscodeEditorMcp.host.description: Loopback interface to bind. Binding a non-loopback address is intentionally not supported.

vscodeEditorMcp.allowWrite.description: Expose tools that modify files (edit_file, create_file, save_file). Edits are applied through the editor's undo stack and are left unsaved unless save_file is called.

vscodeEditorMcp.requireAuth.description: Require a bearer token on every request. The token is regenerated per server start and written to the discovery file.

vscodeEditorMcp.maxFileBytes.description: Refuse to return file contents larger than this many bytes. Tools will suggest a line range instead.

vscodeEditorMcp.sessionIdleMinutes.description: Drop a client session after this many minutes with no requests. MCP clients do not reliably signal disconnect, so without this an exited client stays counted as connected. 0 disables reaping.

vscodeEditorMcp.registerWithCopilot.description: Also advertise this server to VS Code's built-in MCP client, so Copilot agent mode can use the same tools.

vscodeEditorMcp.discoveryDir.description: Directory for discovery files. Empty uses ~/.vscode-editor-mcp.
